whyJoin.headline: Why Join the GLC IPR Cell?
whyJoin.tagline: Build competence, leadership, and professional networks in intellectual property.
whyJoin.intro: Ever wondered who decides that a brand, a song, or an invention actually belongs to someone? That's what we do here. The IPR Cell at GLC Mumbai is for anyone curious about patents, copyrights, trademarks, and the newer frontier — AI, data, and digital rights that most classrooms haven't caught up to yet. You don't need prior mastery — just the ambition to learn and execute.

benefits.title: Unrivalled Substantive Depth
benefits.description: Engage with patents, media copyrights, design protections, and algorithmic IP well beyond the standard curriculum.

benefits.title: Flagship Execution Experience
benefits.description: Directly organise and manage India's premier Trademark Opposition Competition, National Certificate Courses, and Colloquiums.

benefits.title: Elite Professional Network
benefits.description: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior partners from India's top law firms, senior advocates, and corporate counsel.

benefits.title: Publication & Research Profile
benefits.description: Contribute to and edit the GLC IPR Journal in collaboration with leading legal databases like Manupatra.

benefits.title: Grassroots Pro Bono Impact
benefits.description: Deliver actionable IP guidance to student creators and grassroots innovators through the IPR Clinic.

hierarchy.eligibility: Students in Year V-I (5-Year BLS/LLB) or Year III-I (3-Year LLB) of Government Law College, Mumbai
hierarchy.responsibilities: Active participation across research tasks, workshop logistics, competition drafting support, and committee initiatives.

hierarchy.eligibility: Elevated at the conclusion of the academic year based on demonstrated performance and commitment
hierarchy.responsibilities: Lead specialized departments including Research, Creatives, IPR Clinic, Logistics, Finance, and Public Relations.

hierarchy.eligibility: Elevated from top-performing Junior Core members
hierarchy.responsibilities: Define institutional strategy, mentor junior members, oversee national flagships, and manage faculty/bar relations.

selectionProcess.name: Application Submission
selectionProcess.detail: Fill out the formal application articulating your motivation, academic standing, and interest in IP law.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting & Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Interactive interview round assessing problem-solving approach, intellectual curiosity, and commitment.

selectionProcess.name: Induction & Orientation
selectionProcess.detail: Final selection announced followed by departmental orientation and project allocations.
